purpose: Say that something is possible or true without an expected action.
keywords: Vない stem + ずとも; する → せずとも
You can grasp the main point without reading it all.
The feeling came across without words.
There is plenty of time even without hurrying.
formation: Vない stem + ずとも; する → せずとも
restrictions: Often expresses that a step is unnecessary.
mistake: For ichidan, remove ない; for godan use the negative stem.
